spirit:busDefinition.spirit:name: szg_dac_ad911x
spirit:busDefinition.spirit:description: SZG-DAC-AD911X SYZYGY peripheral pinout as exposed by the syzygy_dac IP: 12-bit parallel data (DB), forwarded sample clock (CLKIN), reset/pin-mode (RESET/PINMD), and 3-wire SPI control (SCLK, CS_B, and a single bidirectional SDIO pad). Manager = FPGA side. NOTE: SDIO is one bidirectional wire here -- the IP's IOBUF is internal, so this bus carries a single 'sdio' leg rather than the i/o/t triple.
